review_title: Damaged on arrival and wrong color sent!
review_text: I ordered black headphones, but received silver ones with a cracked headband. The packaging was torn and the charging cable was missing. Completely unacceptable for a premium product.

review_title: Charged twice on UPI but order shows failed
review_text: Money was deducted twice from my bank account via Google Pay (₹1,24,999 each time), but the website gave an error and the order was never confirmed. Customer care is not answering.
